description: This file defines the Resource type and associated functions for managing resource attributes in the OpenTelemetry SDK, including creation, merging, comparison, and serialization.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Immutable object representing an entity with identifying information and metadata, including attributes and schema URL.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructs a Resource using provided options, possibly returning partial resources or errors.

methods.name: NewWithAttributes
methods.description: Creates a Resource with specified attributes and schema URL.

methods.name: NewSchemaless
methods.description: Creates a Resource from attributes without a schema URL.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the Resource.

methods.name: MarshalLog
methods.description: Marshals the Resource for logging purposes.

methods.name: Attributes
methods.description: Returns a sorted slice of the Resource's attributes.

methods.name: SchemaURL
methods.description: Returns the schema URL associated with the Resource.

methods.name: Iter
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the Resource's attributes.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks if two Resources are equivalent based on attributes.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges two Resources into a new Resource, following OpenTelemetry rules.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Returns a default Resource with standard attributes.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Creates a Resource from environment variables.

methods.name: Equivalent
methods.description: Returns a comparable object for Resource equality checks.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Returns the attribute set of the Resource.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes in the Resource.

methods.name: Encoded
methods.description: Returns an encoded string representation of the Resource.
